_comment: A UserPromptSubmit hook that re-surfaces the user-level CLAUDE.md each turn (it loads once at session start and fades over a long session). The install-claude skill merges this 'hooks' block into ~/.claude/settings.json and copies claude-md-reminder.sh to ~/.claude/hooks/. Tilde does NOT expand in hook command strings; $HOME (an inherited env var) does. If a machine's harness turns out not to expand it, the skill rewrites the command to an absolute path. UserPromptSubmit is an event where a hook's plain stdout is injected into the model's context; the script just prints one line pointing back at CLAUDE.md. It blocks nothing and the model may ignore it. No script logic at all — CLAUDE.md holds the actual guidance.
